best_idea: Cull each unit with a cheap bounding sphere before any transform or exact box test, then sort the survivors by definition, texture and uniforms and rebind state only when it changes.
decision_why: Take the two-stage cull and the bind-on-change order for the zone unit renderer; do not port the per-definition cache as instancing, since the donor does not instance; keep visibility as server-applied state, not the donor's client line-of-sight flag.
acceptance: In a zone with 60 or more units in view on a phone, a client test asserts that six models over two definitions bind each definition once (the sketch test gives defBinds 2), and that a unit whose sphere is off screen never reaches the exact box test; players see steady frame time in crowds.
